## Balloon information

### Balloon measurements

- mass 36.4 grams
- circumference 1 - 180 cm
- circumference 2 - 215 cm

```{julia}
#| label: balloon-dimensions
mass = 36.4 # grams
c1 = 180 # circumference x2 cm
c2 = 215 # circumference x1 cm

a = c1/pi/2 # semi-axis radius cm
b = c1/pi/2 # semi-axis radius cm
c = c2/pi/2 # semi-axis radius cm

volume = 4/3 * pi * a * b * c # cm^3
volume /= 100^3 # m^3
```

balloon volume = 0.118 m^3
balloon volume = 118 liter
